g.text: flake.nix webphoneVersion (release.sh greps/seds it) — MUST stay in flake.nix
nix build .#webphone — single Go binary, vendored deps, vendorHash pinned
nix flake check: package · tests · treefmt · island-lint · island-js · island-typecheck · kvm-gated backup VM
imports webphone nixosModules.default — RIDES webphone main (per-train lock bump)
Caddy front: TLS · reverse_proxy (unbuffered /events + /health) · WSS /sip proxy → FreeSWITCH
FreeSWITCH with MIRRORED module set (+xml_int.curl credential bridge) — telephony-eval check pins the module universe
ringhook.py loopback shim → POST /hooks/ring from the dialplan
typed fronts: oauth2 · crm · textagent · passkey · dashboard · backup (secrets via LoadCredential, never rendered)
consumes the stack via a REV PIN — its narHash covers the WHOLE stack tree (must be CLEAN before relock)
telnyx-webhooks.py — the gateway seam's consumer (loopback vs webhook contracts)
webphone-android (P1 native shell — push via ntfy+FCM)
system.db · usermgmt.db · blob tree · traces (ride the backup tar)
backup module: null = single snapshot · set = dated history + prune (webphone-backup + restore-drill checks)
webphone catalog export — asyncapi.yaml (/hooks/* + SSE) + openapi.json (bare filenames, path: pinned)
PUSH webphone → stack re-pins (lock bump) → stack tree CLEAN → pbx-artmann re-locks → release.sh gates on vulnix
